metadata.case_name: LAU MING WAH v. YAU KA FAI AND ANOTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: Merchandiser (involved in sales and public relations) employed by R.I. Overseas Ltd.
plaintiff.occupation_after: Proprietor of own garment trade business (started September 1987); intervening employment with Tuna Fong, Trueway Ltd., and Hong Kong Wearhouse

injuries.description: Multiple laceration wounds over the right side of her face and eyelid.
injuries.body_part: right side of face and right eyelid
source: (i) Multiple laceration wounds over the right side of her face and eyelid.

injuries.description: Partial damage to right facial nerve due to contusion.
injuries.body_part: right facial nerve / face (affecting facial movement and eyelid closure)
source: (ii) Partial damage to right facial nerve due to contusion.
paralysis of the right facial nerve.

injuries.description: Berlin's oedema of right macula and irregular astigmatism of the right eye due to corneal oedema.
source: (iii) Berlin's oedema of right macula and irregular astigmatism of the right eye due to corneal oedema.

injuries.description: Remaining cicatrical octropion causing irritation to the right eye.
source: (iv) Remaining cicatrical octropion causing irritation to the right eye.

injuries.description: Permanent and unsightly disfigurement (hypertrophic/keloidal facial scars including: 'A curved hypertrophic scar measuring 7cm extending from her right cheek to the temple hairline', 'a similar curved hypertrophic scar measuring 8cm in the lower part of her right cheek extending to the pre-auricular region of her right ear', 'a 6cm pigmented hypertrophic scar in the left jaw', and 'scattered scars ... in the right upper eyelid, chin and the neck region').
injuries.body_part: face (right cheek, temple, pre-auricular region, left jaw, right upper eyelid, chin, neck)
source: I am satisfied that the plaintiff's scars constitute a permanent and unsightly disfigurement.
On examination, the followings were noted:- (1) A curved hypertrophic scar measuring 7cm extending from her right cheek to the temple hairline.
(2) A similar curved hypertrophic scar measuring 8cm in the lower part of her right cheek extending to the pre-auricular region of her right ear.
(3) A 6cm pigmented hypertrophic scar in the left jaw.
(4) Scattered scars were noted in the right upper eyelid, chin and the neck region.

manifestations.description: residual double vision at extremes of up-gaze
poor eyelid apposition on attempted closure
pain and watering on waking from sleep; it is consequently necessary to apply a protective cream at night
facial pressure garment was worn at night for about a year
insomnia every night with fragmented sleety and frequent nightmares
Concentration is considerably reduced, her memory is poor
her self-esteem is extremely low and she has become indecisive being unable to cope with simple tasks which previously she did not even recognise as difficult eg. simple housekeeping decisions
Interest in food has reduced ... she lost about twenty pounds in weight
In terms of her mood Mrs. Lau is permanently sad
Socially Mrs. Lau is reduced to virtual isolation
the scars in her right cheek and left jaw region were still obvious although they were improved. These were probably permanent and only minimal improvement could be anticipated in the future.

treatments_received: Initial treatment in the Surgical Unit of Queen Elizabeth Hospital
followed up in the Plastic Surgery Unit, Princess Margaret Hospital
scar revision and multiple Z plasties (1st February 1986)
monthly plastic surgery review and treatment of the scars
treatments_future: psychiatric support / intensive psychotherapy for at least two years (recommended by Dr. William Green)

losses.description: Permanent and unsightly disfigurement from hypertrophic/keloidal facial scars with consequent cosmetic disability and reduced prospects.

Concentration is considerably reduced, her memory is poor, her self-esteem is extremely low and she has become indecisive being unable to cope with simple tasks which previously she did not even recognise as difficult eg. simple housekeeping decisions.
Domestically there has been an equally devastating result ... her husband will have little to do with her and openly states that because she is so disfigured he regrets having married her.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: The plaintiff was conscious of her appearance and lacked confidence, particularly because of the damaged eyelid and distortion to the mouth caused by the damaged facial nerve.
Socially Mrs. Lau is reduced to virtual isolation.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: She has become indecisive being unable to cope with simple tasks which previously she did not even recognise as difficult eg. simple housekeeping decisions.

Her employment in her chosen line of work has virtually ceased and her prospects within her culture have been virtually amputated; diminished earning capacity and reduced prospects in sales/public relations because of appearance.

comparable_cases.injury_description: minor cosmetic disability included in overall award
